title: Double U
description: This mod adds lots of Cool, Useful, Funny, and potential SCARY things to Minecraft!
body:
Cool minecraft mod that adds in stuff that's Cool, Useful, Funny, or even potentially, Scary.

# **Why you should download this mod (if you want to)**

This mod is cool and adds stuff to minecraft that can make it less boring. Sometimes minecraft is hard and boring but this mod can make it easier and less boring but adds in adventure and some scary aspects (if you choose that path)

# **What this mod adds**

This mod adds in Ores, Tools, Blocks, and more! This mod has been worked on for a few days to get everything in this mod.

# **What Ores are in the mod**

The ores in this mod are, Gin, Nether Gin, RedGem, Yurlo, and more coming in the future updates.

# **What specifically to avoid**

If you don't like the "Scary" minecraft mods, then avoid doing anything with the "Devils Items" such as the Crucifix, Demon Resin, Demon Bricks, and Demonic Netherrack.
